notes.title: BUDDY SIMUALTOR 1984 NINTENDO SWITCH RELEASE
notes.notes:
[h1]Buddy Simulator 1984 is available for preorder now and releasing October 27th on the Nintendo Switch![/h1]

Please enjoy this brand new, fully-voiced trailer for Buddy Simulator 1984 on the Nintendo Switch! Spread the word and show the game some love on its first-ever non-PC platform! 

The whole game has been reworked to include controller support and now includes a virtual keyboard! We will soon also be getting the game verified for the [b]Steam Deck[/b]!

[previewyoutube=w7ZyGWtQrXU;full][/previewyoutube]

Preorder the game here: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/buddy-simulator-1984-switch/

Thanks,
Not a Sailor Studios

notes.title: Buddy Simulator 1984 [Update 3.2.3] | Some Small Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! It's been while! I hope you're all having a wonderful day. With the craziness of the Steam Summer Sale and recently finishing college, I decided to take a small bit of time to relax and reset my brain. But, now we're back at it :)

I know it goes without saying, but thank you to everyone for all the endless support you give us. It means the world. <3
-Brandon

[b][*WARNING: SPOILERS AHEAD*][/b]

[b]Okay, so here are some of the recent changes we've added to Buddy Simulator 1984:
[/b][list]
[*] Can now toggle [b]windowed mode[/b] with Alt+Enter.
[*] Save is no longer corrupted if game crashes during Isla transition.
[*] Fixed quite a few typos I'm too embarrassed to mention.
[*] Phoney no longer locks you inside their house after "pinecone" quest.
[*] Can no longer hide from Tiny Joey behind a palm tree. [i]You can never hide from Tiny Joey.[/i]
[*] Tortley will no longer accidentally initiate final quest instead of his "water the flowers" quest.
[*] Buddy no longer exclaims about killing the Snoodlewonker when you should be going to bed instead.
[*] Moved Rudy's junk pile to prevent player from being stuck.
[*] Morton can no longer be placed in front of doorways and [b]important gate entrances[/b].
[*] Tom has a birthday now according to Numbly. Poor Tom :(
[*] Quite a few tiny ones that I never wrote down. [i]Oops.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Buddy Simulator 1984 [Update V3.2.0] | The Groncho Bug
notes.notes:
Hey friends! Sorry this update took so long to get out. I just started my final semester of school, so I've been a tad busy. But lucky for you guys, this patch has fixed our final consistent bug... at least out of the ones we know... unless I created more in this patch.

Fingers crossed, heh.
-Brandon

[b][*WARNING: SPOILERS AHEAD*]
[/b]
So there's probably some extra tiny things that haven't been added to this list, but here are the main ones:
[list]
[*] The infamous[b] Groncho "walking loop" bug [/b]has been fixed! [It turns out only people with Turkish devices ran into this bug. We got you Turkish friends!]
[*] Holding backspace on input box is no longer fidgety.
[*] Eyes no longer flicker to black when blinking.
[*] Added flavor text for crushed Bean child.
[*] Added rimshot sounds to Crank in 2.5D.
[*] Cannot talk to Crank from the front in Toot's Tavern
[*] Fixed sink and oven interaction colliders to be easier to use.
[*] Added more trees during "ending 2" forest sequence.
[*] Can no longer stand on short party members "ending 2" forest sequence.
[*] Walking left from pet in tunnel no longer causes buggy animation.
[*] Added Tortley portrait to Tortley's dialouge during [i]the [/i]scene.
[*] Chase scene during "ending 3" no longer breaks if caught right after final door.
[*] Tweaked band animations slightly to avoid sliding.
[*] No music plays in Bean's house if you stole the Can of Pears. You don't deserve it.
[*] Slightly tweaked Grin's Wingman animations to perform damage in-time with a wink.
[*] Can no longer double slash during... [i]the [/i]scene.
[*] Quitting before the color shifts no longer shows a colored message box.
[*] Fixed game soft lock when party member dies of the [i]Stinky [/i]debuff.
[/list]

notes.title: Buddy Simulator 1984 [Update V3.1.5] Bugs!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Buddy Simulator 1984 [Update V3.1.5]
[/b][/h2]

This update is just a whole lot of bugs! They would have been done yesterday but I sort of, uh, needed a mental health day. Releasing an indie game during college midterms has kept me a bit busy :P
Anyways, there have been a LOT of little bugs squashed today, but these were the big ones:
[list]
[*] - "drawers" is now a possible noun replacement for "cabinet" below the shed.
[*] - Added missing collider on the turning dock lever puzzle.
[*] - Joey no longer leaves his stretched arms after a game over.
[*] - Player is now frozen upon loading into a 2.5D save.
[*] - Fixed common black-screen bug on loading save.
[*] - August 30th is now recognized as a birthday... sorry about that!
[*] - Will no longer defy gravity on stairs during the ending hand sequence. 
[*] - Slowed down player during some Palchumville dialouge moments to prevent trigger skipping.
[*] - Player can no longer get stuck behind the boardwalk stands (Waxed Wick, etc.)
[*] - Pause disabled when naming your first move.
[*] - The player no longer gets knocked back during catch. The ball also loses its velocity once close enough to the player.
[*] - "Go back" is now a possible input for the hidden place.
[*] - Can no longer give your friends infinite compliments.
[*] - Fixed endless-walking Groncho during first fight... I think. I couldn't really recreate it in the first place, so let's hope for the best.
[*] - Data resets no longer wipe Data collectable 'U'.
[*] - Phoney no longer has the same "leave battle" dialouge as Morton.
[*] - If player quits after placing THE sword in river, the sword will still be there upon return.
[*] - Player slowed down during some dialouge sequences in Bluglands to prevent early Rebus initiation.
[*] - Can now interact with Ella during hallway moment.
[*] - Captain Chunk's fight no longer appears after they are befriended.
[*] - Can no longer pause during the credits sequence.
[/list]

-Brandon <3

notes.title: Buddy Simulator 1984 [Update V3.1.4] Walk speed and music Bugs!
notes.notes:
[b]Important bugs related to move speed and music playing have been fixed![/b]
[list]
[*] - Player is now slowed down during [i]bad place[/i] moments to avoid dialogue skipping.
[*] - Player was also slowed down during left tunnel dialogue.
[*] - The happy town music no longer plays during uh, [i]certain places[/i].
[*] - Foot tap no longer continues playing after... [i]stuff happens[/i].
[/list]

notes.title: Buddy Simulator 1984 [Update V3.1.3] New Accessibility Features!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]*WARNING: SPOILERS AHEAD[/b]
[/h2]

[h3][b]The Rad Stuff[/b]
[/h3][list]
[*] -Added a new [b]Settings Menu[/b] to 2D and 2.5D where you can....
[*] -Change music and world volume to make your ears happy! [Note: These changes haven't been applied to the endings just yet, but we're planning it.]
[*] -Change scanlines and bloom intensity to cure your headaches!
[*] -Toggle "[i]One Key Mode[/i]", a new mode for those who find difficulty in combat! An explanation for this mechanic is given in-game. 
[i]Note: We still have more plans for extra accessibility in the future. We want this game to be as inclusive and accessible to as many people as we can. :)[/i]

[*] -Increased movement speed! Roller skates are more speedy now too hehe. 
[*] -Perfect block time has been increased!
[/list]

[h3][b]The Blug Stuff[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] -Leap year birthdays don't crash the game anymore, we got you leap year friends!
[*] -Lardo doesn't soft-lock anymore after giving them a random response.
[*] -Party member colors now update in combat after heals.
[*] -Colliders have been added to out-of-bounds areas in the Bluglands (How did we not know about those??).
[*] -Added an obvious collider to the bedroom in 2.5D. (Again! How did we not know about this!?)
[*] -Fixed Ginny text overlay bug. Thanks for the find space-mashers!
[*] -Dejo bravisa no longer causes an endless screen-break if glitch moment starting.
[*] -Your buddy still reacts to you finishing all quests even after starting the final quest.
[*] -Dejo bravisa no longer causes a soft-lock when recruiting them.
[*] -A fun new collision system now prevents collider skipping in 2.5D
[*] -Force quitting after watering the flowers no longer causes a soft-lock.
[*] -Added pauses to all important buddy dialogue in 2D.
[*] -There's a lot of other little things, but I uh, didn't right them down. I did fix them though! For sure. Probably.
[/list]

[h3][b]The Future Stuff[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] -More accessibility! We want to add more functionality for widescreen monitors and put more focus into hearing-impaired individuals who may struggle with some of the game's audio-based puzzles. We'd love to hear about any other ideas you all might have!
[*] -We're going to continue to tweak and balance characters during combat, and pretty much anything battle related.
[*] -BUGS BUGS BUGS BUGS Please keep us informed on the steam forums, in our Discord, or even just PM us on Twitter and tell us about anything you find! We love hearing all about the bugs you discover, and it always helps us to make the game as good as we can make it.
[/list]

Thanks to everyone whose been supporting us.
You mean the world.
It's currently 4AM, so now I sleep. 

G'night friends!

-Brandon <3

notes.title: Only one week until release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37298632/59fd7eed8b07f76af90f251f23b1d401776290bf.png[/img]

[h1][b]ONE WEEK LEFT UNTIL RELEASE! [/b][/h1]

And you bet your butts we aren't pushing it back! Buddy Simulator is still coming February 18th, and we are so excited for you all to see your Buddy once again! We have 3 important announcements so read carefully! 

[h2][b]WE'D LOVE YOUR HELP![/b][/h2]
Whether you're a long time lurker, active Discord member, or just pop in to say hello every once in a while, we would love any help to spread the word. You all are the best community we could ever ask for, and you've done so much for us already. Seeing as the release date is only a week away, it would mean the world to us if you could share out social media posts, spread the word about the game, and even try to get your favorite YouTubers/Streamers interested!

[h2][b]OFFICIAL WARNING![/b][/h2]
This is everyone's official SPOILER warning! As the release draws closer, so do early access keys for the game to many influencers! I am going to warn you all that starting next week, you could potentially see some footage for the full game. Be cautious if you don't want to be spoiled! 

[h2][b]MINECRAFT SERVER![/b][/h2]
Many have asked so we delivered! With the help of our wonderful Discord mod Developer X, we have set up an official Minecraft server that looks exactly like the game! There is a lot of cool stuff to check out, but for now it is mainly a SMP server. Bare with us as we are new to this and it won't be our highest priority for a bit. I hope to see you there! Please use the new text and voice channel for anything MC related.

[b]185.150.191.187:25319[/b] Version 16.5

We're so thankful for this community, and we would appreciate any help you can give by spreading the word! Thank you all for your help, we couldn't do this without you. 

See ya soon,
-Not a Sailor boys <3

notes.title: An Important Update Regarding Buddy Simulator 1984 | NEW RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Whew, okay, DeMarco here with the difficult task of bearing the bad news! Now, for those of you who just want to see the new release date, it's [b]February 18th[/b]! And we are sticking to it, so help me, I will actually like, break my monitor on camera if we fail again (which will suck because it's brand new--THAT'S HOW SERIOUS I AM!)

We have become our worst nightmare--Cyberpunk 1984. This wasn't really an easy decision, especially since this is the third pushback to our release date since we've originally announced that we wanted to release the game in the summer last year. We want to be completely transparent with you all as to why we made this decision.
The biggest factor in this decision was our time management! When planning a project of this scale, it's important to break down every nook and cranny in development. This includes playtesting, bug fixes, and even marketing (which we didn't really give ourselves time for)! We are making great progress with the game, and while we will be able to finish it by our old deadline, we found ourselves crunching to the bone to get it out there. Believe it or not, the last thing we really have to focus on is the soundtrack, which Brandon really wants to dedicate a lot of time towards to make sure it's something he's proud of. He's also our coder. He's.... actually crazy with how much he can do! We don't want to fall into unhealthy practices to make that deadline, especially since we want the release of this to be something we're proud of. For us, a few of the things we didn't account for when budgeting our time were spending the holidays with family, sudden COVID outbreaks affecting people we love, and taking breaks for our mental health.

We've been working all day every day since the summer and we're exhausted, but gosh, we are so excited. We wouldn't have been able to do it without the wonderful support from our fans. Having such a wonderful fanbase for a studio who hasn't even released a full game yet is just... so unreal. It's both extremely wonderful and very terrifying, especially since we're brand new to game dev as a whole.

Thank you to everyone who puts up with our unprofessional indie shenanigans. We're so thankful for all of your support on this crazy game dev learning experience for us.
I think I love you...
Just kidding...
Unless...

-DeMarco
Not a Sailor Studios

notes.title: NEW NEW RELEASE DATE! | Major Buddy Simulator 1984 Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=a4oP-bW92i4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Unfortunate News[/h1]
Hey guys! We're working hard to get Buddy Sim up and running for the December 10th release date! However, we have some unfortunate news to share, so bear with us! We noticed that we were cutting content from the game in order to make the deadline, and we decided that, instead of doing so, we'd like to give ourselves one final extension to make this game the best it can be before its release. Being a small Indie studio of four college students, we're still getting a handle on scope and the process of game development as a whole, so we appreciate your patience and sticking with us since we've embarked on this crazy journey exactly a year ago! We hope pushing back the deadline one final time will make this the game something we're truly proud of. Coincidentally, Cyberpunk announcing that they were delaying their release date to December 10th is what sparked the discussion between us team members, so maybe that game coming out on that day is some sort of divine intervention telling us that we were just a little too ambitious. 



[h1]Better News/New Release Date[/h1]
After a bit of internal discussion, we think, and we hope, and we pray, that the final release date for Buddy Simulator 1984 is January 14th! We think that's the perfect amount of time for us to complete everything and gives us a bit of wiggle room to playtest and add features we previously had to cut.

Thank you all for your incredible patience, and we're sorry with being so last minute with all of this. Thanks also to our wonderful community managers  for sticking with us for so long! You guys rock. <3

With love,
Not a Sailor Boys 


"This should be the last one. For sure. Probably." -Buddy
